packs.challenge_desc: Mira 'Pigeon: Impossible' y completa el minijuego de Dialogue Cloze con puntuación perfecta.

phrases.meaning: Very easy and uncomplicated to do.
phrases.meaning_es: Pan comido / Muy fácil de hacer.
phrases.example: Passing the flight test was a piece of cake for the veteran pilot.

phrases.meaning: Wait a moment; be patient and slow down.
phrases.meaning_es: Espera un momento / Ten paciencia / No te apresures.
phrases.example: Hold your horses! We can't launch the rocket until the countdown hits zero.

phrases.meaning: Face a painful or difficult situation bravely.
phrases.meaning_es: Hacer de tripas corazón / Afrontar una situación difícil con valentía.
phrases.example: He decided to bite the bullet and apologize for the misunderstanding.

phrases.meaning: Goodbye; an informal way of saying see you later.
phrases.meaning_es: ¡Nos vemos luego! / Hasta más tarde.
phrases.example: I've gotta run to the train station, catch you later!

phrases.meaning: Not important or not a serious problem.
phrases.meaning_es: No es para tanto / No hay problema.
phrases.example: Thanks for sharing your cookies! — No big deal, anytime!

packs.badge: Semana de Emociones y Lazos Familiares
packs.challenge_title: Desafío de la Empatía: Alcanza las Estrellas
packs.challenge_desc: Mira 'One Small Step' y escribe una reflexión en tu diario de inmersión.

phrases.meaning: Remain cheerful and hopeful in a difficult situation.
phrases.meaning_es: Mantén la cabeza en alto / No te desanimes.
phrases.example: Even after receiving the rejection letter, her father told her to keep her chin up.

phrases.meaning: Despite very low probability of success.
phrases.meaning_es: Contra todo pronóstico / A pesar de las dificultades.
phrases.example: Against all odds, the tiny puppy Pip passed every obstacle course.

phrases.meaning: Under all circumstances, no matter how difficult.
phrases.meaning_es: En las buenas y en las malas.
phrases.example: Her father supported her astronaut dreams through thick and thin.

phrases.meaning: An apparent misfortune that eventually results in something good.
phrases.meaning_es: No hay mal que por bien no venga / Una bendición disfrazada.
phrases.example: Missing the early train was a blessing in disguise because she met her best friend.

phrases.meaning: To do the same job or pursue the same path as someone before you.
phrases.meaning_es: Seguir los pasos de alguien.
phrases.example: She wanted to follow in the footsteps of legendary NASA astronauts.

packs.badge: Semana de la Naturaleza y Amistad
packs.challenge_title: Pacto Callejero: Domina el Word Match
packs.challenge_desc: Empareja 10 términos de animales y rescate en el minijuego de Context Word Match.

phrases.meaning: Two completely different individuals who forge a deep bond.
phrases.meaning_es: Amigos improbables / Una amistad inesperada.
phrases.example: The fierce alley kitten and the giant pitbull became unlikely friends.

phrases.meaning: Pursuing a mistaken line of thought or accusing the wrong person.
phrases.meaning_es: Buscando en el lugar equivocado / Meando fuera del tiesto.
phrases.example: If you think the dog ate your homework, you're barking up the wrong tree!

phrases.meaning: Avoid restarting a conflict or bringing up an old argument.
phrases.meaning_es: No busques tres pies al gato / Deja las cosas como están.
phrases.example: We resolved the argument yesterday, let's just let sleeping dogs lie.

phrases.meaning: To relieve tension and start conversation with a stranger.
phrases.meaning_es: Romper el hielo.
phrases.example: The kitten tapped the tennis ball to break the ice with the new puppy.

phrases.meaning: Being too inquisitive can lead one into dangerous trouble.
phrases.meaning_es: La curiosidad mató al gato.
phrases.example: Be careful opening that secret briefcase; curiosity killed the cat!

packs.badge: Semana del Humor y la Ironía
packs.challenge_desc: Identifica los modismos en Simon's Cat y supera el laboratorio auditivo de pares mínimos.

phrases.meaning: Doing or planning something dishonest or mischievous.
phrases.meaning_es: Tramando algo malo / Haciendo travesuras.
phrases.example: Look at Simon's cat sneaking under the blanket; he's up to no good!

phrases.meaning: To make someone extremely annoyed or irritated.
phrases.meaning_es: Sacar a alguien de sus casillas / Desesperar.
phrases.example: The constant meowing at 5 AM was driving him up the wall.

phrases.meaning: To playfully deceive someone as a joke.
phrases.meaning_es: Tomarle el pelo a alguien.
phrases.example: Relax! I didn't actually eat your whole box of cookies, I was just pulling your leg!

phrases.meaning: Very early in the morning as soon as daylight breaks.
phrases.meaning_es: Al rayar el alba / Al amanecer.
phrases.example: The rooster and the cat both woke the farm up at the crack of dawn.

phrases.phrase: Cost an arm and a leg
phrases.meaning: To be extremely expensive.
phrases.meaning_es: Costar un ojo de la cara / Ser carísimo.
phrases.example: That artisanal espresso in the hipster cafe cost an arm and a leg!

packs.badge: Semana de la Ciencia y la Imaginación
packs.challenge_desc: Mira 'Coin Operated' y completa el Sentence Scramble en menos de 2 minutos.

phrases.meaning: Extremely delighted, happy, and thrilled.
phrases.meaning_es: Más feliz que una lombriz / En las nubes de alegría.
phrases.example: The little boy was over the moon when his coin rocket finally rattled to life.

phrases.meaning: To aim for the highest goals and never limit yourself.
phrases.meaning_es: Apunta a las estrellas / Apunta alto.
phrases.example: Her shoemaker dad always told her to reach for the stars.

phrases.meaning: Extremely good, impressive, or extraordinary.
phrases.meaning_es: Fuera de este mundo / Extraordinario.
phrases.example: The 3D animation quality of Blender Studio's Spring is out of this world!

phrases.meaning: Practical, realistic, and unpretentious.
phrases.meaning_es: Con los pies en la tierra / Sencillo y humilde.
phrases.example: Despite winning an Oscar, the director remained completely down to earth.

phrases.meaning: Happening only very rarely.
phrases.meaning_es: Una vez a las mil quinientas / Muy rara vez.
phrases.example: A student finds input so engaging only once in a blue moon.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning: When the person you were just talking about suddenly appears.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning_es: Soltar la sopa / Revelar un secreto.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning: To go to bed and sleep.
daily_phrases_bank.meaning_es: Irse a dormir / Pegar la oreja.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning: Good luck! (Used before a show or presentation).
To stop working on something for the rest of the day.
daily_phrases_bank.meaning_es: Dar por terminado el día / Dejarlo por hoy.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning: To worry or complain about something that already happened and cannot be changed.
To sound familiar, even if you can't remember the details.
Looking in the wrong place or blaming the wrong person.
daily_phrases_bank.meaning_es: Equivocarse de camino / Culpar a la persona equivocada.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning: To do something in the cheapest or easiest way possible.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning_es: Estar en el séptimo cielo / En una nube de felicidad.

daily_phrases_bank.meaning: A controversial topic that no one wants to deal with.

daily_phrases_bank.phrase: Take with a grain of salt
daily_phrases_bank.meaning: To not completely believe something someone tells you.
daily_phrases_bank.meaning_es: Tomarlo con pinzas / No creerlo al pie de la letra.
